explanation: Telescope A's advantage between D 0 and D T over the T hops (Finset.sum_range_sub'), split the sum into hops in C and hops not in C (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not), bound each hop in C by eps (so their sum is at most |C| * eps; eps >= 0 whenever C is nonempty) and each other hop by its absolute value.
